items.name: White Tulle Leaf Gown
items.description: An ethereal white gown featuring a sheer tulle overlay and a fitted bodice with thin straps. The dress is adorned with delicate green leafy vine appliqués along the straps, waist, and cascading down the skirt.

items.name: White Tulle Floral Midi Dress
items.description: A white tulle midi dress featuring a deep V-neckline, long sheer sleeves, and a tiered skirt. The dress is scattered with small, delicate floral embroideries along the bodice and skirt, and is paired with nude strappy heels.

items.name: Dusty Rose Puff Sleeve Dress
items.description: A dusty rose mini dress featuring a V-neckline, long voluminous puff sleeves, and a button-down front. The dress has a fitted waist and a flared skirt, paired with matching knee-high boots and a silver choker necklace.

items.name: Black Puff Sleeve Mini Dress
items.description: A black mini dress featuring a square neckline, dramatic puff sleeves, and a voluminous bubble skirt. It is paired with black knee-high leather boots and accessorized with a sparkly thigh band.

items.name: White Ribbed Floral Set
items.description: A white ribbed knit two-piece set featuring a long-sleeved top with a front clasp closure and scalloped, contrast-stitched edges. It is paired with a matching wrap-style mini skirt decorated with small pink floral embroideries.

items.name: White Floral Knit Set
items.description: A white ribbed knit two-piece set featuring a long-sleeved top and a low-rise mini skirt, both decorated with a delicate pink floral print.

items.name: Mint Lace Mini Dress
items.description: A light mint green mini dress featuring a structured bodice with a square neckline and short lace sleeves. The dress is adorned with a pink floral appliqué at the waist and has a sheer lace overlay skirt with a scalloped hem.

items.name: Cream Toggle Coat & Tights
items.description: A cream-colored, oversized coat with a large collar, toggle closures, and a waist tie, worn over a short white skirt. The look is completed with sheer white dotted tights, white slouchy leg warmers, black patent leather Mary Jane shoes, and a small white quilted chain bag.

items.name: Pink Bow Coat & Leg Warmers
items.description: A light pink double-breasted coat featuring a high collar with a large bow and faux-fur cuffs. It is paired with sheer white dotted tights, cream lace-up leg warmers, and black patent leather Mary Jane heels.

items.name: Blue Pinstripe Midi Dress
items.description: A light blue pinstriped midi dress featuring a V-neckline, ruffled cap sleeves, and a peplum waist. The skirt has an asymmetrical, high-low hem and is accessorized with a sheer neck scarf, a silver chain-strap bag, and black strappy sandals.

items.name: Pink Dress & Black Bow
items.description: A light pink sleeveless mini dress featuring a ruffled bodice and tiered skirt, accented with a large black bow at the neckline. The look is completed with a black quilted chain bag, white socks, and black Mary Jane heels.

items.name: Black & White Tulle Dress
items.description: A black sleeveless mini dress featuring a ruffled white neckline, a white waistband, and a voluminous white tulle skirt. The look is accessorized with a pearl necklace, a pearl bracelet, white dotted tights, and black patent leather Mary Jane shoes.

items.name: Cream Coat & Tulle Skirt
items.description: A cream-colored double-breasted coat featuring a high collar with a large bow and faux-fur cuffs, worn over a matching long, flowing tulle skirt. The look is completed with cream tights and black cap-toe Mary Jane heels.

items.name: Pink Fur-Hood Puffer Coat
items.description: A long, light pink puffer coat with a faux-fur hood and toggle closures, worn with light pink dotted tights. The winter look is completed with cream slouchy leg warmers and light pink boots.

items.name: White Knit & Pearl Set
items.description: A white ribbed knit two-piece set featuring a long-sleeved top with a ruffled neckline and a matching fitted maxi skirt with a flared hem. The outfit is accessorized with a pearl necklace, a fuzzy white bag, and white cap-toe Mary Jane heels.

items.name: White Ruffle Maxi Dress
items.description: A white, form-fitting maxi dress featuring long sleeves with ruffled cuffs and a ruffled neckline with a front bow. The dress has a cascading ruffle detail down the side and is accessorized with a white hat, a lace choker, and white cap-toe heeled sandals.

items.name: Cream Floral Mini Dress
items.description: A cream-colored short-sleeved mini dress with a white collar, featuring a delicate pink and green floral print and a lace-trimmed hem. The look is accessorized with a small pink quilted handbag, ruffled white ankle socks, and pink strappy shoes.

items.name: Peach Satin & Blue Trousers
items.description: A peach-colored satin tunic with wide sleeves and light blue frog closures, cinched with a matching light blue sash. It is paired with wide-leg light blue trousers.

items.name: Pink Sheer Nightgown
items.description: A light pink, sheer babydoll-style nightgown with thin tie straps and a lace-trimmed bodice.

items.name: Black Hoodie & Striped Socks
items.description: A black zip-up hoodie with a faux-fur hood and ribbed hem, layered over a black top and denim shorts. The look is completed with grey and black striped thigh-high socks and grey boots with faux-fur trim.

items.name: Olive Coat & Floral Dress
items.description: A long, olive green tailored coat worn open over a flowing, floral-print maxi dress. The look is accessorized with a patterned green scarf, grey gloves, and brown lace-up leather boots.

items.name: Blue Cheerleader Uniform
items.description: A blue and white cheerleading uniform featuring a sleeveless top with "CHEERS" text and a matching pleated mini skirt. The look is completed with white ankle socks and white sneakers with black stripes.

items.name: Navy Cheerleader Uniform
items.description: A navy blue and white cheerleading uniform featuring a sleeveless crop top with "CAYS" lettering and red trim, paired with a matching pleated mini skirt. The look is accessorized with a red, white, and blue pom-pom, white knee-high socks, and white sneakers.

items.name: Pink Off-Shoulder & Maxi Skirt
items.description: A light pink two-piece set featuring an off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top with a folded neckline and lace trim. It is paired with a matching low-rise, floor-length skirt patterned with small bows, and styled with white pointed-toe heels.

items.name: White Floral Cape Coat
items.description: A white cape-style coat featuring a vibrant floral print, a large white faux-fur collar, and matching fur trim along the hem. It is accessorized with layered gold necklaces, a small brown chain-strap handbag, cream knee-high socks, and light-colored shoes.

items.name: White Floral Knit Set
items.description: A white matching two-piece set featuring a long-sleeved turtleneck sweater and a pleated midi skirt, both decorated with a vibrant floral print. The look is accessorized with layered gold necklaces, a small brown handbag, cream slouchy socks, and metallic shoes.

items.name: Beige Knit & Mint Skirt
items.description: A beige cable-knit poncho-style sweater with a large collar and a light green ribbon bow, worn over a matching knit top. It is paired with a light mint green midi skirt featuring delicate floral embroidery and light-colored pointed-toe heels.

items.name: White Satin Blouse & Mini Skirt
items.description: A white satin V-neck blouse with voluminous sleeves featuring ruched detailing and long drawstring ties. It is paired with a short, heavily textured white mini skirt, opaque white tights, and white pointed-toe pumps.

items.name: Cream Sheer Knit & Textured Dress
items.description: A cream-colored oversized sheer knit sweater layered over a matching maxi dress with heavily textured, three-dimensional floral appliqués. The look is completed with metallic silver pointed-toe heels.

items.name: Yellow Bear Overalls & Striped Shirt
items.description: A bright yellow overall set featuring a large front pocket and colorful cartoon bear and star graphics. It is worn over a long-sleeved shirt with bold red, yellow, blue, and green stripes, paired with white sneakers.

items.name: Red Mickey Mouse Overalls
items.description: A red short overall dress featuring a large Mickey Mouse graphic on the bib and "FUNNY MOUSE" text on the pocket. It is worn over a black and white striped t-shirt and paired with red sneakers.

items.name: Polka Dot Swing Dress
items.description: A vintage-style navy blue and white polka dot dress featuring an off-the-shoulder neckline and a full, flared skirt. The skirt reveals a bright red tulle petticoat underneath and is accessorized with a black hat, black gloves, a red clutch, and red pumps.

items.name: Pink Floral Vintage Dress
items.description: A vintage-style light pink dress featuring a large floral print, short puff sleeves, and a sweetheart neckline. It has a fitted bodice and a full, pleated midi skirt, accessorized with a wide-brimmed straw hat with a pink bow, a pearl necklace, white lace gloves, and silver strappy heels.

items.name: Green Embellished Set
items.description: A vibrant lime green two-piece outfit featuring a crop top with a deep V-neckline and detached, voluminous off-the-shoulder sleeves. It is paired with a matching mini skirt, both textured with metallic embellishments and silver waistbands.

items.name: Tribal Shaman Costume
items.description: A dark, tribal fantasy costume featuring a horned headpiece, a tattered, layered cloak, and a top adorned with bone details. The look includes a fringed, distressed skirt and is accessorized with a tall, ornate staff covered in beads and talismans.

items.name: Pink Tulle Ballet Dress
items.description: A light pink ballet dress featuring a fitted bodice with sheer, voluminous ruffled cap sleeves and a short, layered tulle skirt. It is worn with sheer pink tights and pink ballet slippers.

items.name: Polka Dot Ballet Dress
items.description: A theatrical ballet costume featuring a black velvet bodice with a lace-up front and a white tulle skirt with black polka dots and ruffled lace trim. It is paired with pink pointe shoes.

items.name: Blue Satin Floral Slip Dress
items.description: A light blue satin slip dress with thin spaghetti straps and a V-neckline featuring delicate lace trim. The dress is adorned with pink floral embroidery cascading down the side.

items.name: Pink Satin Brocade Mini Dress
items.description: A light pink satin mini dress featuring a delicate floral brocade pattern, thin spaghetti straps, and a square neckline. The dress has a fitted bodice and a structured, slightly flared skirt.

items.name: Goldfish Print Mini Dress
items.description: A white mini dress with thin spaghetti straps, featuring an all-over print of orange goldfish.

items.name: Green Floral Slip Dress
items.description: A light green satin slip dress featuring a vintage-style floral and damask print. It has a V-neckline with lace trim, thin straps with small bow accents, and a fitted, A-line silhouette.

items.name: Purple Sweatshirt & Pink Joggers
items.description: A light purple cropped sweatshirt with a colorful anime graphic, paired with light pink baggy jogger sweatpants. The look is accessorized with a small purple crossbody bag, silver chain details, and chunky white sneakers.

items.name: White Cardigan & Plaid Skirt
items.description: A white long-sleeved knit cardigan with a faux-fur trim and a front tie, worn over a pink and white plaid mini skirt. The look is accessorized with white tights featuring a bow pattern down the front, a pearl choker, and chunky black platform Mary Jane shoes.

items.name: Pink Floral Sweater & Mini Skirt
items.description: An oversized light pink knit sweater featuring large 3D flower appliqués, worn over a white ruffled mini skirt. The look is accessorized with a small brown shoulder bag, white slouchy leg warmers, and tan platform boots.

items.name: Pink Fur Coat & Mini Skirt
items.description: A long, light pink faux-fur coat with a large collar and cuffs, worn open over a matching pink top and a short, pale pink ruffled mini skirt. The look is accessorized with a pink structured crossbody bag with a gold heart detail, white thigh-high socks, and light-colored lace-up boots.

items.name: Black & White Trackset
items.description: A black short-sleeved crew-neck t-shirt with a small center-chest trefoil logo is paired with white elastic-waist track pants featuring a matching logo on the upper left thigh. The garments appear to be made of smooth, lightweight synthetic athletic fabric.

items.name: Lavender Denim Casual
items.description: A lavender short-sleeved crew-neck t-shirt with "STAY UNITED" printed on the chest is tucked into blue denim jeans secured by a brown leather belt with a metal buckle. The outfit is completed with red canvas low-top sneakers featuring white laces, white rubber toe caps, and white soles.

items.name: Black Leather Cargo
items.description: A black leather biker jacket with silver hardware is worn over a white graphic t-shirt featuring a chain-style neckline print. Black wide-leg cargo pants are paired with white low-top sneakers.

items.name: Burgundy Layered Casual
items.description: A dark red long-sleeved crew-neck sweater is paired with blue jeans rolled at the cuffs, with a dark grey long-sleeved shirt tied around the waist. The look is finished with black and yellow patterned high-top sneakers.

items.name: Floral Pleated Classic
items.description: A short-sleeved brown button-up shirt with a large pink floral print is tucked into grey pleated trousers with rolled cuffs. Brown suede ankle boots complete the look.

items.name: Navy Burgundy Tailored
items.description: A navy short-sleeved button-up shirt with vertical seam detailing is tucked into burgundy wide-leg trousers secured by a gold-tone belt. Brown leather lace-up boots complete the outfit.

items.name: Cream Tuxedo Formal
items.description: A cream single-breasted tuxedo jacket with contrasting black shawl lapels, pocket trim, and cuffs is worn over a light grey button-up shirt with a black bow tie. Black tailored trousers and black dress shoes complete the formal look.

items.name: Navy Suit Classic
items.description: A navy two-piece suit with a single-breasted, two-button jacket and flap pockets is worn over a crisp white collared dress shirt. Brown suede chukka boots complete the tailored look.

items.name: Equestrian Riding Set
items.description: A white long-sleeved button-up shirt with a light grey tie is tucked into beige riding breeches featuring darker reinforced knee patches and a black belt. Tall black leather riding boots complete the equestrian look.

items.name: Blue Check Smart Casual
items.description: A light blue and white checkered long-sleeved button-up shirt is tucked into beige tailored trousers secured by a brown leather belt with a metal buckle. Brown leather dress shoes complete the outfit.

items.name: Rust Knit Sweatpants
items.description: A rust-colored ribbed knit long-sleeve sweater with a partial front zipper is worn over a white undershirt, paired with grey speckled drawstring sweatpants with dark cuffs. White low-top sneakers with red and green side stripes complete the outfit.

items.name: Grey Lapel Suit
items.description: A grey single-breasted suit with contrasting light beige lapels is worn over a white dress shirt with a red bow tie. Brown leather dress shoes complete the formal look.

items.name: Lavender Floral Slip
items.description: A light purple satin slip dress with a lace-trimmed bodice and thin straps features a vibrant floral and butterfly print. A delicate silver pendant necklace completes the look.

items.name: Coral Halter Dress
items.description: A coral halter-neck mini dress with a deep V-neckline features a large floral and orchid print, a tied front detail with a dangling bead, and a flared hem.

items.name: Black Lace Gown
items.description: A black lace evening gown features a sweetheart neckline, voluminous sheer lace sleeves, a thigh-high slit with a ruffled edge, and a ruffled back detail. Nude pointed-toe pumps complete the look.

items.name: Velvet Floral Gown
items.description: A dark burgundy velvet off-the-shoulder bodice with draped long sleeves is paired with a flowing cream skirt featuring a small red floral print. A delicate layered necklace completes the look.

items.name: Gold-Embellished Black Gown
items.description: A long-sleeved black gown features a high neckline adorned with gold embellishment and a plunging, strappy keyhole cutout. The floor-length skirt flares slightly at the hem to form a small train.

items.name: Fantasy Velvet Gown
items.description: A white gown with a wide off-the-shoulder neckline and long sheer bell sleeves features gold and red trim at the arms. A deep red velvet corset-style waist panel with ornate gold lace edging is accented by a dangling beaded tassel, and a gold medallion necklace completes the look.

items.name: Silver Satin Pajama
items.description: A silver satin long-sleeved pajama-style top with an open front and waist tie is worn over a white lace bralette. Matching wide-leg satin trousers with side piping and white pointed-toe shoes complete the look.

items.name: Striped Summer Set
items.description: A dark green and mustard-yellow vertically striped two-piece set features a thin-strap cropped top and matching high-waisted shorts. Black socks, black leather lace-up shoes, dark oval sunglasses, and a brown leather backpack complete the outfit.

items.name: Burgundy Embroidered Gown
items.description: A deep burgundy satin gown features a square neckline, long fitted sleeves, and a full floor-length skirt with a central panel of white geometric diamond embroidery.

items.name: Victorian Lace Gown
items.description: A cream Victorian-style gown features a high lace collar, voluminous puff sleeves, and a ruffled lace capelet over the bodice. The floor-length skirt is detailed with horizontal bands of lace and finishes with a ruffled train.

items.name: Gold Sequin Set
items.description: A gold sequined two-piece set features a halter-style bra top with draped chains and a matching high-slit maxi skirt with a draped waist detail. Gold strappy heels and a gold arm chain complete the look.

items.name: Highland Plaid Ensemble
items.description: A white long-sleeved lace-up blouse is worn under an olive green and brown corset-style bodice with lace detailing. A rust and black plaid draped overskirt is layered over a long black skirt, accessorized with a plaid shawl and a round pendant necklace.

items.name: Fantasy Fur Cloak
items.description: A light blue quilted bodice is worn under a long light blue cloak with a thick cream fur collar, layered over a cream tunic and fitted light blue leggings. The outfit is accessorized with brown leather gloves, a multi-strap leather belt with a pouch, and tall brown lace-up boots with fur trim.

items.name: Burgundy Tennis Set
items.description: A burgundy one-shoulder sports bra is paired with a matching high-waisted pleated mini skirt. White crew socks and white Fila sneakers complete the athletic look.

items.name: Puma Basketball Set
items.description: A black cropped basketball jersey with orange and white trim features a large "Puma" logo across the chest. Matching black shorts with orange drawstrings, white and orange waistband, and grey patterned side panels complete the athletic set.

items.name: Pink Boxing Set
items.description: A light pink cropped tank top with a black "EVERLAST" logo is paired with matching pink boxing shorts featuring a wide black waistband, black trim, and a central logo patch. A silver chain necklace completes the look.

items.name: Green Hiking Set
items.description: A dark green long-sleeved fitted top is paired with dark brown high-waisted biker shorts. White crew socks and dark blue and grey hiking sneakers complete the outfit.

items.name: Grey Athleisure Set
items.description: A dark grey spaghetti-strap sports bra is paired with light grey high-waisted drawstring sweat shorts with white trim. White scrunched socks and white and grey athletic sneakers complete the look.

items.name: Chicago Bulls Set
items.description: A white sleeveless jersey with red and black trim features "BULLS 23" printed in red, paired with matching white shorts displaying a "CHICAGO BULLS" logo and red bull graphic. The shorts have an elastic waistband and side drawstring ties.

items.name: Lavender Satin Knit
items.description: A lavender ribbed knit V-neck cardigan with front buttons is worn over a matching lavender satin slip midi skirt. Silver strappy heeled sandals complete the look.

items.name: Green Floral Knit
items.description: A bright green cable-knit cropped sweater with short sleeves is paired with a high-waisted white maxi skirt featuring a large green floral print. Brown strappy heeled sandals and a white basket-style handbag complete the outfit.

items.name: Pink Angel Corset
items.description: A pink satin corset with lace trim, front buttons, and a ribbon bow is worn with a white tiered ruffled mini skirt and white lace-topped thigh-high stockings. The outfit is accessorized with large white feathered wings, a white feather fan, and a gold bracelet.

items.name: Ombre Knit Dress
items.description: A long-sleeved fuzzy knit mini dress features a black and white ombre gradient, a contrasting white scalloped collar, and gold button detailing. Black pointed-toe kitten heels with gold buckles complete the look.

items.name: Black Pink Romper
items.description: A black long-sleeved knit romper features light pink contrasting trim at the collar, cuffs, waist pockets, and hems, detailed with gold buttons down the front. Black over-the-knee socks and pink pointed-toe heels with gold buckles complete the outfit.

items.name: Green Glitter Set
items.description: A light green glittery two-piece set features a long-sleeved cropped top with a high neckline and keyhole cutout, paired with matching low-rise flared pants accented by a large fabric rosette at the waist.

items.name: Black Lace Bodysuit
items.description: A black off-the-shoulder bodysuit with a draped, asymmetrical design features white lace trim along the neckline and hem. Opaque black tights and black pointed-toe heels complete the look.

items.name: Striped Lace Romper
items.description: A white and black horizontally striped short-sleeved romper features white lace trim along the scoop neckline, cap sleeves, and leg openings, with a front tie detail at the chest.

items.name: Yellow Fur-Trim Dress
items.description: A yellow floor-length dress with a pink floral print features long sleeves ending in oversized fluffy green fur cuffs, and a hem trimmed with matching green fur.

items.name: Yellow Knit Set
items.description: A pale yellow ribbed knit two-piece set features a collared long-sleeve cardigan with button details and flared cuffs, worn partially open over matching high-waisted flared pants with front buttons and side slits. White pointed-toe shoes complete the look.

items.name: Floral Knit Skirt Set
items.description: A black high-neck knit sweater features a large yellow and green floral pattern with patterned trim at the cuffs and hem. It is paired with a cream maxi skirt decorated with an all-over green and pink floral motif.

items.name: Black Tactical Suit
items.description: A black long-sleeved tactical bodysuit features a high collar, utility straps, and harness details across the chest and thighs. The outfit includes black knee pads, black gloves, and black lace-up combat boots.

items.name: Black Leather Edgy
items.description: A black leather sleeveless bodysuit with a deep V-neckline features a central zipper and a long pendant necklace. Black fishnet tights, a black lace fingerless glove, and black platform lace-up combat boots complete the edgy look.

items.name: Grey Ruffled Layered
items.description: A grey sleeveless button-up top is tucked into a grey asymmetrical ruffled skirt secured by a dark brown belt, layered under a dark grey knit hooded cardigan. Dark grey fingerless gloves, patterned tights, and black knee-high buckled boots complete the look.

items.name: Viking Fur Ensemble
items.description: A brown apron-style dress with embroidered detailing and gold trim is worn over a blue long-sleeved underdress, layered with a grey long-sleeved coat and a thick fur shoulder mantle. The outfit is accessorized with a beaded necklace, a brown leather belt with a pouch, and metal brooches.

items.name: Pirate Corset Outfit
items.description: A white long-sleeved poet-style blouse with wide cuffs is worn under a dark navy velvet corset featuring silver front lacing. Cream fitted trousers are accessorized with a brown leather belt and a decorative silver chain, completed by navy lace-up boots.

items.name: Peasant Apron Dress
items.description: A deep red long-sleeved peasant blouse with a gathered neckline and ruffled cuffs is worn over a matching floor-length skirt. A long cream apron is secured at the waist with a brown leather belt featuring a small hanging pouch, and a cream cloth head wrap completes the historical look.

items.name: Viking Tunic Ensemble
items.description: An orange tunic with gold trim and a central patterned panel is layered over a long red skirt and a dark green open over-garment, accented by a patterned waist sash with hanging tassels. A thick fur shoulder mantle, a multi-layered beaded necklace with a central pendant, and a small pouch complete the historical ensemble.

items.name: Black Embroidered Hanfu
items.description: A black long-sleeved Chinese-style robe features silver floral embroidery along the front placket and wide sleeves, worn over a matching black skirt with a large embroidered floral motif.

items.name: Grey Hooded Avant-Garde
items.description: A dark grey hooded long-sleeve top with a draped, asymmetrical hem is layered over a black top and paired with dark grey drop-crotch harem pants. Black leather knee-high boots with multiple buckles complete the look.

items.name: Red Embroidered Gown
items.description: A vibrant red traditional gown features wide bell sleeves and a fitted bodice, heavily embellished with intricate gold floral embroidery along the sleeves and the long, ruffled train.

items.name: Fantasy Red Adventurer
items.description: A deep red floor-length skirt with a dark hem is paired with a matching red bodice layered under a brown leather corset with front lacing. The outfit features dark green and white slashed long sleeves, a multi-layered pendant necklace, and a large round compass hanging from a chain belt.

items.name: Grey Hooded Tunic
items.description: A grey hooded long-sleeve tunic with draped, asymmetrical fabric and a fringed knit chest panel is cinched at the waist with a silver key pendant. The outfit is completed with black leggings, grey ribbed knit leg warmers, and brown suede boots with faux fur trim.

items.name: Green Velvet Gown
items.description: A dark green velvet gown features a square neckline, long sleeves with flared bell cuffs, and a corset-style laced bodice. The floor-length skirt and cuffs are accented with contrasting gold floral brocade panels.

items.name: Yellow Tulle Floral Gown
items.description: A yellow off-the-shoulder gown features a fitted bodice and a floor-length skirt with a sheer purple tulle overlay that forms draped, flowing sleeves and a train. The dress is embellished with three-dimensional purple floral appliqués along the neckline, bodice, and skirt.

items.name: Blue Embellished Cape Gown
items.description: A dusty blue gown features a plunging V-neckline and a cutout bodice with silver embellished trim, paired with a flowing floor-length skirt. The look includes a matching sheer cape that drapes over the shoulders and trails to the floor.

items.name: Fur Cape Warrior
items.description: A brown leather corset with crisscross lacing and gold trim is worn over a long-sleeved textured top, paired with wide-leg brown trousers. The look is completed with a dark green cape and a thick, textured fur shoulder mantle.

items.name: Red Embroidered Sari
items.description: A red patterned sari with gold embroidered borders is draped over a matching blouse, secured at the waist with an ornate gold belt. The look is accessorized with a large gold necklace and a gold bracelet.

items.name: White Ruffle Halter Set
items.description: A white halter-style crop top with a central ring detail is paired with a matching floor-length skirt featuring cascading ruffled tiers. The outfit is accented by a gold chain belt draped at the hips and gold statement earrings.

items.name: Brown Peasant Dress
items.description: A long-sleeved brown textured floor-length dress with a high neckline is cinched at the waist with a thin brown leather belt. A cream cloth head covering and brown shoes complete the historical peasant look.

items.name: Navy Gold Sari
items.description: A navy blue sari with a heavily embellished gold border is draped over a sleeveless top featuring intricate silver and gold beading. The ensemble includes a metallic gold pleated underskirt and is accessorized with gold earrings and layered gold bangles.

items.name: Lavender Jacquard Dress
items.description: A light lavender floor-length dress with a floral jacquard texture features a V-neckline, half-length puff sleeves, and a buttoned front bodice. A matching choker and brown strappy sandals complete the look.

items.name: Cream Toggle Coat
items.description: A cream fuzzy knee-length coat features a hood, front toggle closures with bow details, and large patch pockets. Cream ribbed socks and dark brown lace-up shoes complete the outfit, accessorized with a brown leather handbag.

items.name: Pink Fur Coat
items.description: A light pink A-line coat features a faux fur collar and wide cuffs with matching fur trim, plus a front bow detail with pom-poms. Sheer patterned tights, cream ribbed leg warmers, and black Mary Jane shoes complete the look.

items.name: Plaid Preppy Set
items.description: A black long-sleeved top is paired with a beige plaid pleated mini skirt and a matching plaid neck scarf. The outfit is accessorized with a brown leather belt, a dark brown handbag, white slouch socks, and brown leather loafers.

items.name: Lavender Polka Puffer
items.description: A light lavender puffer coat with a white polka-dot print features a white faux-fur collar, front bow ties, and a cinched waist with a ruffled hem. It is paired with white tights, layered cream and grey knit leg warmers with pom-poms, and white lace-up fur-trimmed winter boots.

items.name: Leopard Patch Jacket
items.description: A grey leopard-print zip-up jacket with black trim features small animal graphic patches on the chest. It is paired with a tan gathered mini skirt, layered white lace and patterned knee-high socks, and black fur-trimmed lace-up boots.

items.name: Pink Wool Coat
items.description: A dusty pink wool coat features a wide draped collar, long sleeves, and a belted waist with a fabric rosette detail. Nude pointed-toe pumps complete the look.

items.name: Plaid Cape Coat
items.description: A grey plaid cape-style coat features a large faux fur collar and matching fur cuffs, worn over a coordinating plaid skirt. The look is accessorized with tan leather gloves, a beige quilted chain-strap handbag, sheer black tights, and brown suede knee-high boots.

items.name: Mint Fuzzy Coat
